provenance: A compacted, self-contained copy of the full-suite detector in lib/test-suite-lock.ts. A copy on purpose: a subject whose source is the live module moves every time the module does, and a control that moves is not a control.

cases.defect: The redirect pattern lost its `&` alternative, so `&>` and `&>>` are not recognised as redirection operators.
cases.failureScenario: `bun test &>/tmp/out` leaves the token `&>/tmp/out` in the operand list. It contains a `/`, so the detector calls the run targeted and returns false, and the guard built on it lets an unscoped full suite through. The doc comment one line above still claims `&>>` is covered, so the file contradicts itself in the diff.

cases.why: A behaviour-preserving refactor of the same baseline: two locals renamed and the operand test extracted to a named function. test/review-negative-control.test.ts proves the premise by running baseline and candidate over the same command table and requiring every row to agree.
